fields.heightCm: Optional number normalized from cm or ft/in; missing is not zero
fields.bodyweightKg: Optional number normalized from kg or lb; missing is not zero

constraints: No automatic BMI, somatotype or appearance classification
Omitting both measurements still permits later plan generation with required training inputs
Separate applicable health-data decision before collection; WIN-007 terms are not a substitute
Uncertain readiness has a pause route, not a forced ready answer
persistence: Future private server-authorized profile; no collection or backend implemented by this proposal

navigation.depends_on: WIN-007; WIN-008 where required; authenticated identity
